name: read_content
rests_on: Host-registered content backend, else bytes this process clipped. No backend and no stored body: content unavailable. Does not import a trace or memory package.

digest.description: Optional 12 to 64 hex digest from a <page digest="..."> or <ref digest="...">. Omit to continue the latest page in this turn.

next.description: Continue the latest page. Offset becomes that page's next_offset. Digest is optional.

session_id.description: Session the page belongs to. Omit to use the current turn session. Passed through to the host backend.

offset.description: Character offset into the full body. Omit with next true to use next_offset from the latest page.

limit.description: Maximum characters to return. Default is AGENTS_PAGE_CHARS (32768) or workspace config page_chars. A negative limit reads through the end.
